name: factorypuzzle
description: RATIO - a gridless factory-ratio puzzle prototype, top-down 3D for mobile

scripts.test: node test/refs.test.js && node test/sim.test.js && node test/levels.test.js && node test/newlevels.test.js && node test/factory.test.js && node test/harness.js
scripts.verify: npm test > /tmp/ratio-test.log 2>&1; code=$?; if grep -q ' FAIL ' /tmp/ratio-test.log; then echo '--- failing assertions ---'; grep -n ' FAIL ' /tmp/ratio-test.log; echo VERIFY_FAILED; exit 1; fi; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then tail -30 /tmp/ratio-test.log; echo VERIFY_FAILED; exit 1; fi; echo VERIFY_OK
